title: Hover Mode (precise aerial positioning)
description:
Purpose: A slower, controllable floating state for combat positioning and construct placement. Toggle via A Button double-tap. Provides strafe, minor altitude nudge, body bob suppression for aim stability, drift correction, and instant braking from flight.

Controls (Quest 3 — verbatim):
- A Button: Double-tap to toggle hover or flight where allowed.
- Left Thumbstick: Strafe while hovering.
- Right Thumbstick up/down: minor altitude nudges if pitch/altitude assist is enabled.

Params (params_json):
- hover_max_speed_mps (float, default 1.2)
- hover_accel_tau_s (float, default 0.12)
- altitude_nudge_step_m (float, default 0.25)
- altitude_bounds_m (vec2, default [0.5, 25.0]) relative to local ground or zero-G ref plane
- damping_tau_s (float, default 0.20)
- allowed_in_scenes (array[string], optional) to restrict indoors
- comfort_hand_stabilize (bool, default true) to reduce micro jitter for aiming

Behaviour:
1) Detect double-tap A within 0.35s window. If flight is active, this acts as an instant brake into hover.
2) When hover_active:
   - Compute desired lateral velocity from Left Stick, clamp by hover_max_speed_mps and accel/decel taus; write to CPhysics/CLocomotionVelocity.
   - If Right Stick vertical is above threshold and assist enabled, nudge altitude by altitude_nudge_step_m per input tick, clamped within altitude_bounds_m.
   - Apply drift correction and damping to stop smoothly when sticks released.
   - Apply hand stabilization (if enabled) by adding a minor smoothing filter to the weapon/construct aim anchor transform.
3) On exit (double-tap A): freeze velocity to zero and hand off to ground or flight systems based on player state.

Components:
- Reads: CInput, CSceneTag, CTransform, CPhysics ground probe, CComfortState.
- Writes: CLocomotionMode (set to Hover), CLocomotionVelocity, CAimStabilizer.

Comfort rules:
- Speed-capped, gentle damping on release, no camera roll. Instant brake into hover.

Acceptance hooks:
- Satisfies test_hover_toggle in training_arena and derelict_space_station.

Integration and depends_on:
- Flight system uses this as its brake/transition target.
- Depends on haptics_manager for a subtle periodic hover hum pulse and a toggle click.

Assets/scenes:
- Active in training_arena, derelict_space_station; also used in open areas when flight is disabled.

Suggested file split: hover_mode_register.cpp, hover_mode_update.cpp, hover_mode_input.cpp.
